item.title: GUESTS 209 – everdasha – radio.syg.ma
item.description: Cologne-based everdasha maps the terrain where the academic meets the ethereal. As a multimedia artist and co-curator of the decolonial zine Agasshin, her practice draws on culturology to assemble personal mythologies from poetic fragments and dream-logic.

item.title: expired 13 – semi lux – radio.syg.ma
item.description: A touching, soft one-hour world by semi lux, weaving together edits of old internet nostalgia, anime moods, emos and trap textures.

item.title: Wide.Mesh (Riforma) – estuary..fragmentation – radio.syg.ma
item.description: Wide.Mesh has a hyperdimensional anti-nucloid, “mesh” is just a metaphor for us little sonic shells. It spreads around the fabric of time-space, what we understand from it comes from love and trust (faith?). For this episode we entangle new connective tissues with estuary..fragmentation, whose release “sedimentary flash diary” was the first for Riforma this year! item.title: Unline Frequencies – Earshot XVII – radio.syg.ma
item.description: radio.syg.ma is a community platform for mixes, podcasts, live recordings and releases by independent musicians, sound artists and collectives.

item.title: Habitat – rally_k – radio.syg.ma
item.description: Illbient drifts, weird trad post-occitan taste, jazzy mazes, droney stoney sounds with some Ape Cars passing by, selected and mixed for you by rally_k in between some mountain villages.

item.title: Peripherie 20 – Matryoshka – radio.syg.ma
item.description: For the 20th edition of Peripherie, Igor Dyachenko welcomes Seattle's Jacqueline Lawson with an emotive mix of quiet lyricism and intimacy, presented through delicate sonic forms. “a journey from the depths to the clouds, and from heaven to earth. let yourself accumulate and disperse.”

item.title: EMST – Parete Del Tempo by Kinked – radio.syg.ma
item.description: “sonic materialities of processing, fluid manipulations, a collection of unedited components tense towards the shadows This is a sound collage i made as a dialogue between personal audio materials from the making-of my new album The Struggle Of Making Time Habitable, and inspiring experimentations from different decades of sonic practitioners. The last song of the mix is dedicated to my friend Aniello and all The Invisibles out there.” // Kinked

item.title: GUESTS 210 – aiel – radio.syg.ma
item.description: An eclipse induced mix, an hour of ambient bass sounds to etherial late night calls.

item.title: walking for two w/ Timmyia – radio.syg.ma
item.description: It is no small thing to walk as two, when the other pair of footsteps lives only in the wish. So I walk in silence. Not in sadness, but in the hush that comes after a storm. This is a walk for acceptance, resilience and softness.

item.title: GUESTS 211 – Luigi Turra – radio.syg.ma
item.description: Luigi Turra (b. 1975) is a reductionist/electroacoustic composer, concerned with the aural balance between silence, tactile perception of sound and aleatoric music. Trough the manipulation of human voices, digital, concrete and acoustic sources, he develops acoustic paths in which listeners experience continuous pauses and abrasive sound tensions, touching the areas of experimental sound poetry.
